sloka: अस्मि इदानीम् अहम् प्रप्ता हत श्रवण नासिका ।शोणित ओघ परिक्लिन्ना त्वया च परिसमन्विता ॥३-२१-७॥
transliteration: asmi idānīm aham praptā hata śravaṇa nāsikā ।śoṇita ogha pariklinnā tvayā ca parisamanvitā ॥3-21-7॥

translations.english: My ears and nose sliced off, drenched with blood, I came to you and you pacified me.
